units.name: AllocateProjectile
units.summary: Choose the slot pool from type Y, search backward to its type-specific lower bound and initialize position/status/type and motion template. Carry clear means allocated; set means pool full.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: DrawActorSlots
units.summary: Visit actor slots one through six, prepare signed X-page and position, then draw ordinary or negative-type effect graphics.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: DrawNegativeActorType
units.summary: Low type bits select an effect pose; blink near timer expiry before drawing composite style two.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: DispatchActorGraphics
units.summary: Count the per-slot flash timer and dispatch graphics by actor type minus four through the bound scene table.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: DrawActorDirectionalFrame
units.summary: Select a scene/type frame table, use horizontal velocity sign to choose facing and frame bit eight to select animation phase, then draw composite style two.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: UpdateEncounterSlots
units.summary: Visit four active record pointers, advance duration/subtype counters and derive spawn positions from mode bits. Allocate actors from the bounded slot pool and resume the iterator.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: ConsumePassedSceneEvents
units.summary: Compare the 16-bit scroll progress with ordered eight-byte event thresholds. Consume reached records and dispatch by two low event-type bits; $ff is the terminal marker.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: CallSceneEventHandler
units.summary: Tail call the event handler pointer in scratch $57/$58.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: DispatchSceneEventSubtype
units.summary: Use event byte-three low bits to choose a second handler table.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: InstallTimedEncounter
units.summary: In normal player form, convert the event selector into an eight-byte encounter pointer and install its duration/countdown bytes.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: ClearEncounterPointers
units.summary: Clear four two-byte encounter pointers using offsets six, four, two and zero.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: ClearEncounterPointer
units.summary: Zero one two-byte pointer in the encounter pointer array.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: AllocateEventActor
units.summary: Search actor slots six through one for an empty status, initialize event position/page/type/template and health, load motion, then dispatch the event-specific Y initializer.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: LoadObjectTemplate
units.summary: Save bank and object slot, select template bank four, multiply the template ID by sixteen and add the ordinary/special base. Copy sixteen bytes to a RAM scratch record, restore bank and return scratch pointer.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: ApplyObjectMotionTemplate
units.summary: Copy fifteen consecutive template bytes into parallel per-object velocity, acceleration, steering and AI arrays. X remains the object slot.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: FirePlayerProjectile
units.summary: Consume encoded ammunition; reject when empty or too close to the facing edge. Spawn at an animation-dependent muzzle offset, create an effect and sound, then adjust matching existing projectiles.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: ConsumeAmmunition
units.summary: Three digits use one-based decimal encoding: decrement with borrow by reloading ten. All ones means empty; clear the weapon-available latch and return carry set.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: TestProjectileActorShape
units.summary: Select collision shape from projectile mode and actor metadata, compare half-coordinate positions via banked collision and set hit flash timer on non-player targets.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: UpdateUpperObjectSlots
units.summary: Update slots seven through fifteen, with special timed behavior for type twelve. Integrate motion, resolve tiles and remove objects that leave the screen/page.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: DrawUpperObjectSlots
units.summary: Visit upper slots, choose alternating type graphics from frame bit eight and handle type thirty's timed/status phases separately.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: CheckProjectileHits
units.summary: Scan slots seven through nine for active projectiles, test actor targets and handle the low projectile-type hit response.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: FindProjectileTarget
units.summary: Build projectile half-coordinate position, scan valid visible actors, reject repeated-hit masks and platform types, then run actor-shape collision. Boss mode takes a separate coordinate/shape path.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: UpdateTransientEffects
units.summary: Visit four effect slots; advance expired animation timers and draw each effect at its stored position.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: DrawTransientEffect
units.summary: Count one timer, advance its pose stream if needed and draw with composite style zero while preserving effect-slot X.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: AdvanceEffectPoseStream
units.summary: Choose an effect sequence, read pose/duration pairs and store the new cursor. $ff terminates through the preserved nearby return.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: AllocateTransientEffect
units.summary: Search four effect slots for a zero timer; store sequence, position, zero cursor and one-frame initial timer. A full pool simply returns.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: LoadGraphicsUpperPatternTable
units.summary: Index the graphics-list pointer table and set destination pattern-table base $1000 before common synchronous loading.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: LoadGraphicsLowerPatternTable
units.summary: Index the graphics-list pointer table and set destination base zero before common synchronous loading.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: LoadGraphicsDescriptorList
units.summary: Read descriptor pointers from a list until its high byte is zero. Each descriptor is uploaded synchronously; preserve the outer cursor and caller bank.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: UploadGraphicsDescriptor
units.summary: Decode a five-byte descriptor, set PPU destination and source bank, then copy tile_count times sixteen bytes. Restore the descriptor-list cursor; the outer caller restores the bank.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: DecodeGraphicsDescriptor
units.summary: Five bytes are source 16 KiB bank, destination tile index, tile count, and little-endian CPU source address. Destination is tile index times sixteen plus the caller's pattern-table base. Return destination high in A and low in X.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: ReturnFromIrq
units.summary: Single RTI immediately before CPU vectors; no additional IRQ work is established.
units.scope: Classified fragments in this mechanical group only; intervening raw gaps are excluded from interpretation.

units.name: SceneAssetTables
units.summary: Four parallel thirteen-byte scene selector arrays; order background palette, sprite palette, upper graphics, lower graphics.

units.name: GraphicsSelectorPointers
units.summary: Nineteen little-endian CPU pointers, selected by the synchronous graphics loader.

units.name: GraphicsDescriptorLists
units.summary: Bounded pointer lists; high byte zero terminates each list.

units.name: GraphicsUploadDescriptorPool
units.summary: Forty five-byte records: source PRG16K bank, destination tile, tile count and source CPU word. Natural selection remains unresolved for seven records.

units.name: HardwareVectors
units.summary: Three little-endian CPU vectors in NMI/reset/IRQ order. NMI is D8FE, not FED8.

units.name: ContinueVoiceEnvelope
units.summary: Rejoin the envelope decoder after increasing base volume toward its target.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ContinuePackedEnvelope
units.summary: Repeat packed-nibble decoding at the current envelope cursor.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: StoreVoiceSlideTargetHigh
units.summary: Fetch the high period byte from the note table and retain the channel scratch index for the common event tail.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: SetVoiceControlParameter
units.summary: Copy one stream operand into voice field two. Its exact sound-level interpretation remains unresolved.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: SetVoiceEnvelopeSelector
units.summary: Install the stream-selected envelope index and return to common command advancement.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: SetVoiceParameter6
units.summary: Set voice parameter six from one stream operand. Its sound-level use remains unresolved.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: SetVoiceFlagsAndVolumeTarget
units.summary: OR stream flag bits into voice state, set the target volume, and restart the shared envelope tick.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: AddVoiceTranspose
units.summary: Add the signed stream operand to the per-voice transposition byte, wrapping at eight bits.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: AudioDebugBreak
units.summary: Back up the stream cursor and execute BRK. IRQ RTI resumes after the separate signature byte; it does not execute that byte as RTS.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DisableVoiceSlide
units.summary: Clear pitch-slide flag $20 and back up Y because this command has no operand.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: SetVoiceSweepCache
units.summary: Use the voice channel low bits to select one of the sweep caches, store the operand, and restore the voice index.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: SuppressVoiceRegisterWrites
units.summary: Set flag $02 so the voice advances without writing hardware registers; no stream operand.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ResumeVoiceRegisterWrites
units.summary: Clear flag $02 and compensate the no-operand command cursor.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DisableRawVoicePeriod
units.summary: Clear raw-period flag $08 so subsequent events again use note-table encoding.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: StartPrioritySoundAlternate
units.summary: Mute cached output, latch high priority and clear flag $10 on the six paired voices before joining descriptor initialization.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: LoadDirectNametableRuns
units.summary: Read the fixed source at $b46d as destination-word/run records and write PPU bytes directly. The destination-derived $e3 marker terminates. Rendering must permit direct writes.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CopyDirectNametableRun
units.summary: Read a one-byte count and stream that many source bytes to PPUDATA.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: AdvanceDirectNametableSource
units.summary: Increment the source cursor and carry its wrap into the pointer high byte.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: AdvanceUiRectangleCell
units.summary: Queue the current metatile, advance column/source cursor, then wrap to the saved first column and next row until the exclusive endpoints are reached.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ApplyUpperSlotContactDamage
units.summary: Enter the shared player-damage path after an accepted overlap.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: HandleActorPickupContact
units.summary: Queue sound $1c and pass the collision result in Y to the fixed pickup/award service.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ApplyBossContactDamage
units.summary: On overlap set the player hit-flash timer to sixty and enter the common damage response.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ConsumeTransformationCharge
units.summary: Search charge slots six through zero. Clear the first occupied slot, preserving special value $12 as $13, and request effect $20.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ApplyPlayerDamageState
units.summary: Set player damage flags and a 180-tick timer, queue sound nine, then save the prior main state and enter state eight. Decrement the life digit and enter its display helper.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ContinueCompositePartLoop
units.summary: Rejoin the clipped composite renderer's next-part path.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: UpdateSceneExitPlayer
units.summary: While player flag $40 is clear, draw the timer-selected pose and consume charge effects every fourth tick. Timer exhaustion enters state eleven, clears the player and advances/wraps the thirteen-scene index.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: EnterFinalSceneExit
units.summary: Select scene twelve, a signed transition delay and main state eleven.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: QueueSceneOverlayRun
units.summary: Queue a type-two transfer from the fixed scene source with destination low byte derived from the scene timer.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: BeginBossPoseScript
units.summary: A selects a four-byte descriptor: stream pointer then completion-handler pointer. Start with duration one and cursor zero.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CountBossPoseTransitionA
units.summary: Count the shared timer while selecting pose script nine; expiration enters boss state four.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CountBossPoseTransitionB
units.summary: Count down while selecting script seven, then enter state two with a long secondary countdown.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ResetBossSceneState
units.summary: Reset boss counters, select gameplay state five and initialize its secondary countdown and scene latch.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CompleteBossPoseWithSound
units.summary: Enter boss state two, queue sound ten and select the next graphics sequence.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: BeginBossDefeatPoseScript
units.summary: Queue sound $17 and select script one.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: BeginBossSceneExit
units.summary: Queue sound eight, enter main state twenty-three and start the player countdown.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: AdvanceBossPoseScript
units.summary: Count the duration, then read duration plus four palette values. A zero duration tail-dispatches the descriptor completion pointer; otherwise update the cursor and publish the palette.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: UpdateBossMapScene
units.summary: Run player/actor services, dispatch the boss state and advance palette scripts. Only selected substates run contact checks; a hit starts a timed response script.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DispatchBossMapState
units.summary: Boss state selects a little-endian handler word; tail-dispatch through shared scratch.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: WaitBossMapCountdown
units.summary: A negative secondary countdown starts the next pose/state. Otherwise use frame masks and random thresholds to alternate boss tile patterns and spawn effects.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: MoveBossMapAcrossPattern
units.summary: Cycle six signed row/column deltas every eighth frame. Horizontal bounds select the next delta half; queue the changed boss map tiles.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: RaiseBossMapPosition
units.summary: Every sixteenth frame decrement the boss row until row four, then enter state five.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: AdvanceBossMapPattern
units.summary: Every sixteenth frame advance the tile pattern. Pattern five starts a sixty-three-tick state-six countdown.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: BeginBossMapRoaming
units.summary: After countdown select the roaming state and pose script, then queue its transition sounds.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: RoamBossMapRectangle
units.summary: Move coarse coordinates every sixteenth frame between horizontal 1..23 and vertical 4..17 bounds, reversing independent direction bits. Queue map tiles after each step.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: SpawnBossMapTimedEffects
units.summary: At frame masks $3f/$7f choose effect IDs and update the active boss tile pattern.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: SpawnBossMapOffsetEffect
units.summary: Convert coarse boss coordinates to pixels, offset the origin and allocate effect $14.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DrawBossMapPattern
units.summary: Compute destination from coarse coordinates, select pattern-specific source, then queue up to five ten-byte type-two strips. Stop at a nametable-column boundary; last screen rows shorten each strip.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: UpdateBossArrivalScene
units.summary: Run common player/actor services and dispatch the arrival substate through the bounded table.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DispatchBossArrivalState
units.summary: Read the handler word indexed by boss state and tail-call it through scratch.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: BeginBossArrivalPose
units.summary: Enter state one and begin pose script zero.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: WaitBossArrivalGraphics
units.summary: Wait for graphics loading to finish, initialize coarse position and a thirty-two-tick arrival timer, then select state three.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CountBossArrivalOverlay
units.summary: While the timer runs queue an overlay strip; on expiry draw the initial boss pattern and begin pose script two.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: UpdateBossPairScene
units.summary: Run common gameplay/contact services and dispatch the boss pair state; skip player-contact service while player status is negative.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DispatchBossPairState
units.summary: Tail-dispatch the boss pair handler indexed by state.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: LowerBossPairOffscreen
units.summary: Every sixteenth frame redraw then lower the coarse boss row. Row twenty-six enters the common damaged/exit transition.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CycleBossPairAction
units.summary: Rotate three actions every sixty frames. If both actor slots are empty select the defeat state; otherwise spawn, move horizontally and position both components.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: MoveBossPairHorizontal
units.summary: Every sixteenth frame advance/reverse the coarse X coordinate at zero and twenty-two, redrawing the boss map.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: SpawnBossPairProjectile
units.summary: During action two, every thirty-two frames allocate from the fixed template, position at the boss origin and orient horizontal velocity toward the player.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: PositionBossPairActors
units.summary: Convert coarse X into two pixel positions sixteen pixels apart, storing each low byte and carry page.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: UpdateBossPairArrival
units.summary: Run player/actor services and dispatch the two-state initialization path.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DispatchBossPairArrival
units.summary: Tail-dispatch through the two-word boss initialization table.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: InitializeBossPairActors
units.summary: After graphics completion load palettes, reset boss state, set coarse coordinates and initialize two actor slots from one shared template.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: InitializeOneBossPairActor
units.summary: A gives pixel X and X gives the slot. Set page/status/Y/type/health/template, then apply movement and animation services.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: BeginBossPairPose
units.summary: Enter state one, queue sound ten and select graphics sequence four.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DrawBossPairMap
units.summary: Select the state-dependent source and queue up to twelve vertical type-two strips. Height is twenty-six minus coarse row; stop at the nametable-column boundary.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: UpdateMaskedBossScene
units.summary: Run common gameplay services, state dispatch and hit-palette handling. Contact checks run only in selected states.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: FlashMaskedBossPalette
units.summary: A hit copies one four-color set and starts an eight-tick restore delay. Expiration copies the alternate set and publishes the palette.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DispatchMaskedBossState
units.summary: Read one state-indexed handler word and tail-dispatch.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: AdvanceMaskedBossTileList
units.summary: Read a zero-terminated tile-index list. Each index expands to a sixteen-byte PPU destination and source offset in $af80; queue a type-eight masked transfer. After five masks enter the exit transition.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: QueueMaskedBossTile
units.summary: Advance the tile cursor, multiply the selected tile by sixteen and build the type-eight transfer payload with its mask selector.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: UpdateBossEmergence
units.summary: While the secondary countdown is active update the boss map and periodic effects; expiration resets pattern/state and queues the transition sound.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: WaitBossEmergenceGraphics
units.summary: After graphics completion start the emergence timer, clear the display latch and enter state two.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CountBossEmergencePose
units.summary: Draw the boss actor while counting its pose timer. At selected ticks load alternate palette records; expiry changes state.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: MoveEmergingBossActor
units.summary: Move actor one on frame masks, advance state at X $6c and redraw the actor plus supporting boss map layers.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DrawEmergingBossActor
units.summary: Preserve pixel X while queuing two supporting map layers, then draw the actor with composite style zero.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: BeginBossOscillation
units.summary: After the timer expires initialize boss coordinates, direction and state six, plus actor and template selections.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CycleBossEmergencePalette
units.summary: Every eighth frame select palette record by frame phase. Timer expiration selects the final record and effect; copy twelve bytes before publishing.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: UpdateTeleportingBoss
units.summary: Negative health selects the next graphics/state and hides actor one. Otherwise alternate inactive waits with random bounded spawn coordinates and timed directed effects.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: FireTeleportBossEffects
units.summary: At three timer thresholds allocate effects from the actor origin. Choose side from player X and adjust velocity orientation for the opposite side.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: FireBossMapPairedEffects
units.summary: Frame masks choose one of three projectile types. Allocate two effects at coarse-coordinate offsets, copy the template selector and reverse one horizontal direction.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CycleBossEffectTemplate
units.summary: Cycle the effect-template byte through $bf..$c1.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: InitializeTeleportingBoss
units.summary: Load palette, initialize actor-one type/health/template and animation, enter gameplay state five and queue music.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: OscillateBossMapRow
units.summary: Move coarse row between three and seven every sixteenth frame, pausing at the top; refresh the supporting map layers each step.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: QueueBossUpperLayer
units.summary: Temporarily substitute row four to compute a map address, restore the logical row and select a three-row source.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: QueueBossLowerLayer
units.summary: Compute an address twelve coarse rows below the boss while preserving the logical row; select five or six source rows.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: QueueBossAnimatedLayer
units.summary: Compute the middle layer address eight rows below the boss, select source from frame bit $10 and queue four rows.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: QueueBossBodyLayer
units.summary: Compute the body address and source; row three suppresses the body transfer. Otherwise queue eight rows.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: QueueBossLayerRows
units.summary: Queue twelve-byte type-five rows. Advance destination by thirty-two and source by twelve until the row counter expires.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: UpdateMultiActorBossScene
units.summary: Run common player/actor/contact services then dispatch the two-state multi-actor boss handler.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: WaitBossPartsDefeated
units.summary: When actor slots two through four are inactive, queue sound eight and enter the common transition.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: SpawnBossChildParts
units.summary: Once actor one disappears, create three child actors at shared X and differing Y offsets, with templates/types derived from per-part constants.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: InitializeBossChildPart
units.summary: X selects the actor, A its Y offset and Y its template. Copy the parent's origin, set status/page/type/health and apply template/animation.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: InitializeMultiActorBoss
units.summary: Set actor-one position, type, health and template, enter state five and initialize its movement and animation.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: UpdateSegmentedBossScene
units.summary: Run common gameplay services then dispatch the three-state segmented boss handler.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CountSegmentedBossPalette
units.summary: Count down with palette changes at four sixteen-tick thresholds; expiry selects state two.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: LowerSegmentedBossRows
units.summary: Every sixteenth frame queue a bounded map strip, update segment appearance and increment the coarse row. Row twenty-two completes the transition.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: RaiseSegmentedBossRows
units.summary: On timed steps decrement boss row, queue map rows and move each segment eight pixels upward. Restore the timer between steps.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: RestoreBossSegmentSlots
units.summary: Find inactive segment slots and reinitialize them; then select the restoration substate.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CompactRemainingBossSegment
units.summary: Search backward for a surviving segment and move its status/health/Y into slot one, clearing the former slot. Update boss substate and delay.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: LowerSurvivingBossSegments
units.summary: When the timer expires, move surviving segments down eight pixels and advance row/substate, skipping the selected damaged slot.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: MoveBossSegmentUp
units.summary: Move the selected actor Y up eight and refresh its map appearance.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: MoveBossSegmentDown
units.summary: Move the selected actor Y down eight and refresh its map appearance.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: UpdateSegmentedBossAction
units.summary: Run contact services, inspect boss health and animate a timed palette flash. Dispatch secondary state through seven handler words; defeat selects the palette/sound transition.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: WaitSegmentedBossAttack
units.summary: Maintain a two-level countdown; once row twelve is reached select a short attack transition.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: FireAimedBossProjectile
units.summary: Refresh boss map and segment damage. At frame phase $1f allocate a projectile and choose signed horizontal/vertical speeds from player-relative distances, with a nonzero fallback direction.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: RefreshBossSegmentDamage
units.summary: Compare current and cached segment health. A newly defeated segment clears its status and selects the repair substate; otherwise choose a map appearance from health thresholds.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DrawBossSegmentHealth
units.summary: Map health to one of four sources, derive destination from actor Y while preserving boss row, and queue one or two map rows.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: AnimateSegmentedBossMap
units.summary: Every thirty-two frames choose one of two map sources, compute the boss destination and queue eight eight-byte rows.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: BindSegmentedBossMapSource
units.summary: Y selects a word source; combine it with the current boss map destination before queuing rows.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: QueueSegmentedBossMapRows
units.summary: Queue type-five eight-byte rows. Destination advances thirty-two, source advances eight, and the row counter bounds the loop.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: UpdateSegmentedBossArrival
units.summary: Run common services and dispatch the three-state segmented boss initialization.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DispatchSegmentedBossArrival
units.summary: Tail-dispatch through the state-indexed handler word.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: InitializeSegmentedBoss
units.summary: After graphics completion clear substates, initialize coarse position and a two-level timer, create six segments and select gameplay state five.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: InitializeBossSegmentSlots
units.summary: Initialize slots six through one, then set the leading segment's distinct health, position and type.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: InitializeOneBossSegment
units.summary: Give one segment status, health and template; derive vertical position from boss row and slot, then initialize movement and animation.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: BeginSegmentedBossPalette
units.summary: Load palette, set the arrival countdown/state, queue music and select graphics sequence ten.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CountBossArrivalPalette
units.summary: Change two palette entries at sixteen-tick thresholds. Timer expiry selects arrival state one.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CountMovingBossEntrance
units.summary: Every sixteenth frame decrease the timer and queue a shifted map strip; expiry selects state three and starts the player countdown.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ConsumeBossDefeatCharges
units.summary: Every fourth tick consume a transformation charge and update its display if successful; continue the player countdown afterward.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: PopBossDefeatCharge
units.summary: Search charge slots backward, clear/update the first occupied slot and request effect $20. Carry clear means consumed; set means none remain.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: SpawnBossEndingActors
units.summary: Draw the ending group, then use a sixteen-tick cadence to introduce up to five actors at player-relative positions with staggered animation timers.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DrawBossEndingGroup
units.summary: Reserve sprite zero, draw the player and four child slots through the banked renderer. The preceding timer-gated entry begins blinking when the player countdown expires.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: BlinkBossEndingPlayer
units.summary: Read signed-terminated duration entries, toggle player visibility and hide its OAM entry during off phases. Terminator starts main state two.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DrawBossEndingChildren
units.summary: Visit four active slots, toggle pose when each timer expires, then draw the selected composite pose at stored coordinates.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CountMovingBossPalette
units.summary: At countdown thresholds copy one of three four-color groups into both palette halves; expiration advances boss state and resets the timer.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CopyMovingBossPalette
units.summary: Copy four colors in reverse index order into two parallel palette groups, then publish the update.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: QueueBossEntranceStrip
units.summary: Compute the boss strip source and offset it by eighteen minus the entrance timer before entering the shared strip queuer.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: UpdateFinalBossArrival
units.summary: Run common services then dispatch the one-word initialization handler.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DispatchFinalBossArrival
units.summary: Tail-dispatch the final boss arrival handler through scratch.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: InitializeFinalBossActor
units.summary: Create actor one with fixed position/type/health/template, initialize movement/animation, clear boss state/direction and queue sound ten.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: FinishResetRamAndDisplay
units.summary: Complete RAM clear through $0700, initialize PPU shadows and stack, select bank six and clear input/NMI flags. Initialize palettes/OAM/nametables, load initial graphics and enter title state nine.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: QueueFinalFormHudPart
units.summary: Queue HUD selector $20 through the common source/destination/count tables.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: BeginContinueSelection
units.summary: Prepare the title-style screen. Later scenes show three HUD elements and enter selection state twenty-four; earlier scenes reset progression and return to title.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: UpdateContinueSelection
units.summary: Start accepts the selected option. Select toggles a two-choice cursor and redraws its paired HUD elements.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: AcceptContinueSelection
units.summary: A nonzero choice returns to title; otherwise constrain the scene, convert to a zone selection and enter state twenty-five after drawing the prompt.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: UpdateZoneSelection
units.summary: Start accepts the selected zone; Select cycles available zones, wrapping to one, and redraws the selected HUD label.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DrawZoneSelection
units.summary: Clear the selection area and queue the zone-number-specific HUD source.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: AcceptZoneSelection
units.summary: Convert the selected zone to an even scene index, restore the selected RAM preset and enter scene state eleven.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: PrepareTitleStyleScreen
units.summary: Clear scroll, blank display, load title assets, clear nametables and wait for frame/vblank before enabling display.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: BeginTimedTitlePrompt
units.summary: Prepare the screen, queue HUD selector seven and enter state thirteen with a 120-tick delay.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: FinishTitleInitialization
units.summary: Enable display, select title palettes/music, queue title HUD elements and initialize a two-byte timer before entering state ten.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: QueueTransformationSound
units.summary: Queue sound $11 after selecting transformation graphics.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: QueueTransitionHud
units.summary: Queue the two HUD elements needed at the end of the form transition.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CheckDemoStreamEnd
units.summary: Compare both bytes of the advanced demo pointer with its bound; equality returns to title state nine.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: AdvanceDemoInputPointer
units.summary: Advance the input/duration pair pointer by two with carry into its high byte.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: RepeatScenePointerBinding
units.summary: After clearing an active object, rejoin the backward slot-clearing loop.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: BeginEndingTextScreens
units.summary: Blank display, load ending graphics, set the first HUD selector and initialize the page counter and long timer; enter ending state seventeen and queue sound thirteen.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: UpdateEndingTextScreens
units.summary: Count the page delay, reload graphics on the selected page and queue successive HUD selectors up to its boundary. Advance the page and enable display; the last page enters state eighteen.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DrawEndingTextPage
units.summary: Use the page index for the banked screen and palette, then drain sequential text/HUD sources. Add the three final-page elements at selector $4e.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: BeginEndingActorScene
units.summary: Load graphics/palettes and the banked screen, enable display, position the player and clear four actor slots. Enter state three with a sixty-tick delay.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: InitializeNextEndingActor
units.summary: Read per-slot Y/timer tables and activate the next ending actor with pose/type one.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: RemoveEndingActorsInOrder
units.summary: At sixteen-tick intervals deactivate successive actors. After five slots switch to the next ending sequence.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: BeginEndingEffects
units.summary: Select the sprite palette, clear sequence counter and enter state twenty-one.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: UpdateEndingEffects
units.summary: Draw ending actors and transient effects. Every sixteenth frame allocate an effect at the next table coordinate and queue sound $1f; after seven effects enter state fourteen with a delay.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: BeginEndingDeparture
units.summary: Blank display, draw the banked departure screen, wait and enable display. Position actor one, enter state fifteen and start its 180-tick timer.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ContinuePlayerPoseSelection
units.summary: Rejoin the player pose selector after choosing this state-specific path.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: SelectPlayerPoseBase
units.summary: Load the established pose-table base before the common player draw tail.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ResolveObjectVerticalContact
units.summary: After stepping the selected object, probe terrain. A successful contact updates motion and clears status bit $04; empty/inactive handling remains in the shared surrounding loop.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CarryObjectXPageForward
units.summary: Increment X page when the low coordinate crosses zero, then continue common motion integration.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CarryObjectXPageBackward
units.summary: Decrement X page when the low coordinate wraps to $ff, then rejoin motion integration.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ClearObjectStatus
units.summary: Deactivate the selected object by clearing its status byte.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: SelectActorScoreAward
units.summary: Use actor metadata's award field and sign bit to choose one of the score-digit increments. Separate dispatch entries handle charge/life/ammunition awards.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: AwardTransformationCharge
units.summary: Saturate the charge count at $ff, then add the corresponding encoded score increment.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CarryScoreDigitAddition
units.summary: Propagate an encoded decimal carry through score digits, restore the display preset and queue its HUD source.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: AwardEncodedLifeDigits
units.summary: Add the life award through one-based decimal digits, carry at eleven, restore its RAM preset and refresh the form-dependent HUD.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: AwardEncodedAmmunitionDigits
units.summary: Increment ammunition digits with one-based decimal carry, restore the preset and queue its HUD element.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: FacePlayerVelocityNegative
units.summary: Set the sign bit of the player's horizontal velocity while preserving magnitude.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: BorrowEncodedDigit
units.summary: On decimal underflow reload ten and continue the borrow loop across preceding digits.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: EnterPlayerDeathTransition
units.summary: Select state twenty-two and clear the player's form/type.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ClampSceneProgressToCheckpoint
units.summary: Select the scene's checkpoint threshold list and quantize sixteen-bit progress to its preceding sixteen-unit threshold. Final scene uses the fixed fallback and returns to scene eleven.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ProbePlayerRightFoot
units.summary: Run the right-side terrain probe and make a one-pixel horizontal correction when rising against a low-valued tile.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ResolvePlayerPlatformContact
units.summary: Restore the saved selector, reject inappropriate contacts and remember the supporting actor slot. Use player/platform shape to place player Y and return carry set; alternate path sets status bit $08.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ProbePlayerFootSpecialTile
units.summary: Subtract form-specific foot correction, convert to a clamped 0..12 row and scroll-adjusted column, then read collision cache. Return comparison flags against tile $32. External callers remain unresolved.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: FinishPlayerActionLatch
units.summary: Restore the saved accumulator and clear the action latch before the common action tail.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: AdvanceCameraOnePixel
units.summary: Increment pixel scroll and toggle nametable on wrap. At sixteen-pixel boundaries advance scene progress, update events and boundary state; intermediate columns queue the next map cell.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: RepeatCameraCarryWork
units.summary: Rejoin the shared camera-progress carry path on zero.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CheckSceneProgressBoundary
units.summary: At sixteen-unit boundaries compare coarse progress with the scene's threshold and set the boundary latch. Selected even scenes queue an approach sound one unit earlier.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ScrollActorsAndEncounterTimers
units.summary: Move each active actor left one pixel, updating page and culling beyond the left margin. Update four encounter timers and clear their pointers when they expire.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: UploadMaskedTile16
units.summary: Clear vertical PPU increment, save bank and decode the queued bank/mask/destination/source fields. AND exactly sixteen source bytes with the selected mask, write PPUDATA, then restore the prior bank.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: RestoreBankAfterNametableFill
units.summary: Pop and restore the mapper selection saved by the banked nametable helper.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DrawBankedEndingScreen
units.summary: Save the selected bank, choose bank five, call its screen entry and restore the prior mapper selection.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DrawBankedDepartureScreen
units.summary: Bank-preserving wrapper for the next bank-five screen entry.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DrawBankedEndingPage
units.summary: Preserve the selected bank across the bank-five page drawing entry; Y carries the page selector.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: UpdateBankedChargeDisplay
units.summary: Select bank five for its charge-display helper, then restore the saved bank.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: FinishBankedBossContact
units.summary: Call the bank-five boss contact entry and restore the mapper selection.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: FinishBackwardPresetCopy
units.summary: Complete the backward byte-copy loop, including offset zero, then return. The backward order preserves overlapping source/destination semantics.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ReadRawColumnMetatileBanked
units.summary: Save bank, select five and enter the raw-column accessor; join the ordinary metatile queuer's matched restore path. No external caller established.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: BindAndReadMapMetatile
units.summary: Bind the current twenty-six-byte map block before reading the requested row/column.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ComputeRawColumnMetatileAddress
units.summary: Use the raw metatile column and enter the coordinate accessor. External caller unresolved; the bank-five wrapper establishes the required data window.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: RenderIncrementalMapCell
units.summary: Select the scene layout bank, use fine scroll as row and column seventeen, then bind/read/draw/cache one map cell before restoring the prior bank.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ContinueActorSlotLoop
units.summary: Return to the actor-slot iterator after one object's work.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: SkipActorEffectWhenTimerActive
units.summary: Return through the common actor tail while its effect timer remains nonzero.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ReturnInactiveActor
units.summary: Return after the selected slot has been cleared.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CopyPlayerHorizontalSpeedHigh
units.summary: Complete the paired horizontal-speed copy from player to selected actor.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CopyPlayerVerticalSpeedTail
units.summary: Complete the player's vertical speed and acceleration copy into the actor arrays.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: TestActorVerticalTrigger
units.summary: Apply a signed configured offset to player Y and compare with actor Y, accounting for overflow and direction selector. Crossing enters the shared template action; otherwise return.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CountActorTriggerDistance
units.summary: Decrement the high/low trigger counters and wait until both expire before the shared action path.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ApplyActorTemplateAction
units.summary: Read template byte fifteen. Ordinary values replace template/motion; special $fc..$ff values select mask clearing, deactivation, randomized negative-type conversion or a shared alternate path.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ClearActorHitMasks
units.summary: Walk the other slots and clear the selected actor's mask bit before deactivation. The three-byte inline table is separate Data.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ClearActorStatusAndPage
units.summary: Deactivate the actor and clear its X page.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ChooseRandomActorEffect
units.summary: Use two deterministic-table samples to reject by threshold, then subtract an eight-entry weight list to select a negative actor type. Initialize its timer or clear the actor if selection is out of range.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: RestoreActorVerticalTemplate
units.summary: Unless the contact flag is set, reload three vertical motion bytes from the current template.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ToggleActorHorizontalAcceleration
units.summary: On steering-timer expiration invert acceleration sign and reload the template's horizontal timer field.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ToggleActorHorizontalVelocity
units.summary: On timer expiration invert velocity sign and reload the template's horizontal timer field.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ReturnHorizontalSteering
units.summary: Return when the configured horizontal band requires no change.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ToggleActorVerticalAcceleration
units.summary: On timer expiration invert acceleration sign and reload the template's vertical timer field.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ReturnVerticalAccelerationSteering
units.summary: Return when the configured vertical band requires no change.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ToggleActorVerticalVelocity
units.summary: On timer expiration invert velocity sign and reload the template's vertical timer field.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ReturnVerticalVelocitySteering
units.summary: Return when the configured vertical band requires no change.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ResolveActorLeftTiles
units.summary: Probe leading-side terrain, apply the actor-specific contact response and probe again. Rising actors against low-valued tiles move left one pixel with page borrow.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ResolveActorRightTiles
units.summary: Probe leading-side terrain twice around the contact response. Rising actors against low-valued tiles move right one pixel with page carry.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ApplyActorTileResponse
units.summary: Type $11 enters the shared template action; ordinary actors receive a negative vertical impulse unless already in contact. Type $0d in the selected zone clears horizontal motion.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: FireActorTemplateProjectileA
units.summary: Use actor slot and frame phase for a sixty-four-frame cadence. Template $a8/$ab selects side and projectile type; reject positions that wrap offscreen.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: FireActorTemplateProjectileB
units.summary: At the actor's periodic phase, template $3b emits a projectile from its left edge.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: FireActorTemplateProjectileC
units.summary: At the actor's periodic phase, template $7f emits a projectile from an elevated left origin.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: TriggerActorTripleProjectiles
units.summary: On first close horizontal contact with the player, latch status bit $40 and allocate three projectile types from the actor origin.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: TriggerActorDistantTriple
units.summary: Once the player reaches the actor's sixty-pixel approach band, latch status bit $40 and allocate a different three-projectile group.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: FireActorDirectionalTriple
units.summary: At periodic frame phase select template $19 or $1b, choose side/height offset and allocate three related projectile types.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: FireActorCooldownProjectile
units.summary: When its timer is clear, template $29/$2c selects a side-specific elevated origin and allocates projectile type twelve. Apply short/long cooldown around allocation.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: FireActorTemplateProjectileD
units.summary: At periodic frame phase template $51/$53 chooses the origin side and projectile ID eight or forty.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ContinueActorDrawLoop
units.summary: Return to the common actor drawing iterator after the current slot.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ContinueEffectActorDrawLoop
units.summary: Return to the actor drawing iterator after the negative-type effect path.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: TestActorFlashPhase
units.summary: Use frame parity to suppress the current actor's flash-frame drawing path.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ApplySceneActorFlashRules
units.summary: Selected scene/type combinations increment the hit-flash byte or rejoin the ordinary graphics handler. Other combinations return without drawing here.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DrawActorTemplateSpecialPose
units.summary: Templates $a8/$ab select two fixed poses by horizontal direction; other templates use the common directional frame renderer.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DrawActorFourFrameCycle
units.summary: Use frame bits three/four to select four consecutive poses beginning at $8a.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DrawThreePartActor
units.summary: Direction and frame bit eight select three four-entry pose arrays. Push two pose IDs, draw the bottom part, then pop/draw higher parts with vertical offsets sixteen and thirteen. No external caller established.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DrawActorTimedPose
units.summary: Increment the actor timer; choose pose $3e before tick thirty-two and $3d afterward.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DrawActorFacingPlayer
units.summary: Select one of two frames from player-relative X, unless the hit-flash byte supplies the alternate two-phase selector.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DrawActorPairedCycle
units.summary: Template $53 selects the alternate pair, while frame bit eight alternates within the pair.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DrawTwoPartActorCycle
units.summary: Preserve template ID across the first draw, raise the second part twenty-four pixels and select its pose from template side and timer threshold.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: AdvanceEncounterSpawnTimer
units.summary: Count down the encounter's low-nibble duration, reload count and subtype from its record, derive spawn page/position from encounter mode and invoke allocation before resuming the four-slot iterator.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ContinueEncounterSlotLoopA
units.summary: Rejoin the encounter slot iterator after this mode-specific branch.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ContinueEncounterSlotLoopB
units.summary: Rejoin the encounter slot iterator after this alternate mode branch.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: AllocateSceneEventActor
units.summary: Choose the actor-slot ceiling from the encoded type, search for an inactive slot and initialize X/page/status/type/template/health. Load motion from banked template and enter event-specific positioning dispatch. A full pool returns unchanged.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ApplySceneEventPalette
units.summary: Use event byte seven to select four background colors and queue the palette update.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: CopyEventPaletteGroup
units.summary: A selects destination group and four-byte color source; copy four consecutive bytes into the palette buffer.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: BeginSceneEventGraphics
units.summary: Use event byte seven as the graphics-sequence selector.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: GateTimedEncounterByPlayerForm
units.summary: Skip timed encounter installation while the player is transformed; ordinary form continues.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: InstallEncounterRecordState
units.summary: Use event byte seven as encounter slot or signed clear command. Initialize cursor/count/timer, extract mode from event byte two and set page/position, then publish the record pointer.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: SelectEncounterPointerToClear
units.summary: Mask the clear selector to two bits and convert it to a word offset in the four-pointer array.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: InitializeEventActorPage
units.summary: Clear actor X page and join the shared allocation/template path.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DispatchEventActorPosition
units.summary: Extract three initializer bits from event byte two and tail-dispatch through eight handler words. Source record remains in scratch $53/$54.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: PositionEventActorRelativeToPlayer
