units.summary: Use event byte four as signed Y offset, subtract the player's form correction and add player Y.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: PositionEventActorAndVerticalTarget
units.summary: Use relative-player positioning and also store the resulting Y in the actor's vertical target field.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: PositionEventActorAbsolute
units.summary: Copy event byte four directly into actor Y.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: KeepEventActorPosition
units.summary: Return without changing the actor's initialized position.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: PositionEventActorOnGround
units.summary: Scan collision-cache rows for tiles $0a..$1f. Convert the first accepted row plus two into pixel Y; if none exists deactivate the actor.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ContinuePlayerProjectileAdjustment
units.summary: Return to the existing projectile-adjustment loop while more matching slots remain.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: FirePlayerFormProjectile
units.summary: Ordinary form suppresses shooting during two animations and selects a facing-dependent origin. Transformed forms use different projectile IDs/origin offsets; special charge mode queues sound and consumes charge after successful allocation. Reject wrapped/offscreen origins.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ApplyProjectileActorDamage
units.summary: Subtract damage from target health. Underflow marks defeat, selects template/effect by type/scene and clears motion/status through the shared helper; update score, face response and sound. Carry returns the accepted-hit result.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ContinueUpperObjectUpdate
units.summary: Continue the upper-slot loop for the selected special type/status; otherwise enter its timed update.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: AdvanceUpperObjectLoop
units.summary: Return to the common upper-slot iterator.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: SelectUpperObjectTimedPose
units.summary: Choose the special timed/status pose branch from the established flags.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: QueueUpperObjectTransitionSound
units.summary: Queue sound $16 as the upper-object timed transition completes.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ContinueProjectileHitLoop
units.summary: Return to the projectile-slot iterator after checking one projectile.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ApplyProjectileHitStatus

units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: ApplyProjectileTerrainContact
units.summary: On accepted terrain contact set the projectile's negative status bit, then return.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: DamageCoarseBossTarget
units.summary: Convert coarse boss coordinates to collision coordinates, run the banked shape test and, on overlap, queue sound and subtract projectile damage from boss health. Preserve projectile slot across sound handling and latch the boss hit response.
units.scope: Classified instruction members only; intervening Data/Unknown excluded from the operation interpretation.

units.name: SceneMapBlockPointers
units.summary: Thirteen scene-indexed little-endian words. CPU bases for twenty-six-byte terrain blocks; combine with the per-scene layout bank.

units.name: SceneMetatileAttributePointers
units.summary: Thirteen scene-indexed little-endian words. Bank-five attribute arrays, one byte per metatile.

units.name: SceneMetatileTilePointers
units.summary: Thirteen scene-indexed little-endian words. Bank-five tile arrays, four bytes per metatile.

units.name: SceneActorGraphicsPointers
units.summary: Thirteen scene-indexed little-endian words. Fixed-bank graphics dispatch tables; actor type minus four selects a row.

units.name: SceneActorBehaviorPointers
units.summary: Thirteen scene-indexed little-endian words. Fixed-bank behavior dispatch tables parallel to the graphics tables.

units.name: SceneActorCollisionOffsetPointers
units.summary: Thirteen scene-indexed little-endian words. Per-scene offsets used to choose actor collision metadata.

units.name: SceneActorSideOffsetPointers
units.summary: Thirteen scene-indexed little-endian words. Per-scene side/shape offset tables used by actor contact consumers.

units.name: SceneActorMetadataPointers
units.summary: Thirteen scene-indexed little-endian words. Per-scene eight-byte metadata bases, parallel to behavior and graphics domains.

units.name: MovingBossStateHandlers
units.summary: Seven moving-boss state handler words, bounded by state setters and connected routines.

units.name: UiLineTransferDescriptors
units.summary: Thirty-three four-byte records, two CPU cursor words each. The first addresses fourteen source glyphs; the second advances a paired transfer destination/cursor. BeginIncrementalTransfer loads both and sets fourteen ticks.

units.name: DisplayQuantizationRecords
units.summary: Fourteen eight-byte storage records. For an in-range record, LoadDisplayQuantizationRecord copies seven bytes and skips the eighth. The skipped-byte role and full natural selector domain remain unresolved.

units.name: SceneIntroGlyphSequence
units.summary: Glyph/control sequence consumed by the scene-intro text helper until a zero byte.

units.name: ResetBrkSignature
units.summary: BRK signature is skipped by PC+2 on the guarded missing-player-start path; it remains Data.

units.name: AudioNotePeriods
units.summary: Little-endian APU period words at CPU $88aa, indexed by doubled note value. Numeric storage is exposed; the full naturally selected note domain is not asserted.
